scope: Conservative installed runtime dependency closure (dependencies, installed optional dependencies and installed peers) of the Quest, companion, sim, server and shared protocol/control packages, plus the browser-imported emulator packages; supplemental icon attribution and vendored asset notices. This is not a list of modules proven present in every browser bundle, nor all development tools in package-lock.json.

entries.name: @iwer/devui
includedVia: Quest app/emulator.ts imports the emulator UI into an optional browser chunk despite its development-dependency declaration.

entries.name: iwer
includedVia: Quest app/emulator.ts imports IWER into the optional browser emulator chunk despite its development-dependency declaration.

entries.name: lucide-react
includedVia: Installed Lucide icon-set ISC notice, supplementing the implementation notices shipped by @pmndrs/uikit-lucide. This entry does not claim React is used by the Quest UI.

upstreamNotice.name: yoga-layout
upstreamNotice.reason: The installed yoga-layout@3.2.1 package declares MIT but omits the full LICENSE file; copied verbatim from its official repository at the version tag commit.

entries.name: @webxr-input-profiles/assets vendored meshes
entries.versionNote: The exact upstream asset package version was not recorded with these vendored files.
includedVia: Existing full MIT notice accompanying generic-hand and meta-quest-touch-plus GLB assets.

entries.name: JetBrains Mono vendored regular font
entries.versionNote: Vendored font, not an installed npm package; no package version is inferred.
includedVia: Existing full SIL Open Font License accompanying JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf.

entries.name: Inter vendored fonts, CE Inter Tabular and generated MSDF atlas
entries.versionNote: Vendored/derived assets; provenance and reproduction are documented in apps/quest/public/fonts/README.txt.
includedVia: Preserves the exact existing notice accompanying the copied and derived Inter assets, independently of the installed font package version.
